tasks.title: Create loadPersonalInstructions helper
tasks.description:
Create a new file `src/personal-instructions.ts` that exports a single function `loadPersonalInstructions(dataDir: string): string`. The function reads `<dataDir>/instructions.md` if it exists; if the file exists AND its content (after trimming) is non-empty, it returns the string `
PERSONAL INSTRUCTIONS:
<content>
` (where `<content>` is the raw, un-trimmed file contents, matching the format currently used in `src/commands/run.ts` lines 84-92). Otherwise returns `''`. Use `fs.existsSync` and `fs.readFileSync` with `'utf-8'` encoding. Export the function as a named export. Do NOT modify any other files in this task — the wiring into callers happens in later tasks.
tasks.notes: File already existed from previous iteration with correct implementation. All 584 tests pass. Uses fs.existsSync + fs.readFileSync with utf-8 encoding, returns formatted string with PERSONAL INSTRUCTIONS header or empty string.

Use `fs.mkdtempSync` + `os.tmpdir()` for temp dirs. Clean up temp dirs in `afterEach`. Import from `../src/personal-instructions`.
